visualReview.method: Direct visual inspection of original PNG captures after actual Edge interaction tests
findings: App captures show the completed goal, verified revision and saved skill in the actual timeline. App content remains scrollable within its panels.
Offline charts have readable labels at both widths; the narrow table scrolls within its own region.
Replay controls and recorded positions are visible; a top-down point projection is explicitly labelled as retained motion, not newly simulated geometry.
README captions identify actual captures and distinguish JVM heap from process memory.
limitations: Not a new whole-application usability study; existing app layout is preserved.
The full tall desktop chart extends below the capture viewport and remains scrollable in the companion.
